spans.s: Pāścimānūpaka (“inhabiting the western marshy country,” name of a prince and his people). § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2670 (incarnation of the Asura Mṛtapā). Cf. V, 81 (Paścimānūpakāḥ).
Pāśin, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 182 (Dhṛtarāshṭraputranāmak.): I, 117, 4547.--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 51, 2446 (attacked Bhīmasena); 84, 4262 (among ten sons of Dhṛtarāshṭra slain by Bhīmasena).
Pāśivāṭa, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 371 (in the south).
Paśu^1, pl. (ºavaḥ), a people. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 375 (only B., C. has Pattibhiḥ).
Paśubhūmī, a country. § 280 (Bhīmasena): II, 30, 1083 (in the east, conquered by Bhīmasena).
Paśūnāṃ pati(ḥ) = Śiva: XII, 10356 (1000 names^1); XIV, 199.

Pāśupata, adj. (“belonging to Paśupati [i.e. Śiva]”). § 4 (Anukram.): I, 1, 67 (sc. jñānaṃ ?), 160 (mahāstraṃ, cf. § 333).--§ 190d (Arjuna): I, 123, 4800 (astraṃ Pºṃ nāma, all. to § 333).--§ 333 (Kairātap.): III, 40, 1643 (antraṃ, i.e. Brahmaśiras), 1650 (do. do., obtained by Arjuna from Śiva).--§ 440 (Yakshayuddhap.): III, 164, 11900 (sc. astraṃ, among the weapons obtained by Arjuna from Indra).--§ 442 (Nivātakavacayuddhap.): III, 167, 11985 (astraṃ. all. to § 333).--§ 524 (Jayadrathavimokshanap.): III, 272, 15807 (śaraṃ, do.).--§ 561 (Yānasandhip.): V, 48, †1913 (mahāstraṃ, known by Arjuna).--§ 569 (Bhagavadyānap.): V, 141, 4786 (sc. astraṃ, do.).--§ 588 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 121, 5802 (do., do.).--§ 596 (Pratijñāp.): VII, 80, 2838 (ºṃ nāma paramāstraṃ).-§ 602 (Droṇavadhap.): VII, 188, 8604 (sc. astraṃ, employed by Droṇa).--§ 608 (Karṇap.): VIII, 60, 2998 (sc. astreṇa); 79, †4055 (mahāstraṃ, all. to § 333).-§ 696b (Dakshaprokta-Śiva-sahasranāmastotra): XII, 285, 10470 (vrataṃ).--§ 717b (Nārāyaṇīya): XII, 350, 13702 (sc. jñānaṃ ?), 13705 (jñānaṃ, taught by Śiva).--§ 730g (Upamanyu): XIII, 14, 851 (astraṃ, description).
Pāśupatāstra (“the Pāśupata weapon”). § 606 (Tripurākh.): VIII, 34, 1562 (employed by Śiva). Cf. the prec.
Paśusakha, name of a śūdra. § 750b (Bisastainyop.): XIII, 93, 4417 (śūdraḥ, the husband of Gaṇḍā), (4447), 4475, (4501), (4532).
Pāshāṇatīrtha, name of a vedi. § 377 (Dhaumyatīrthak.): III, 88, 8338 (the first of Jamadagni's two vedis in Śūrpāraka).
